sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: As the Democratic Party sifts through the rubble of its sweeping electoral loss and tries to chart a path back to power, few people have as clear-eyed a diagnosis
sentences.zh: 当民主党正在梳理其惨败的残局，并试图寻找重掌权力的道路时，很少有人能像佛蒙特州的参议员伯尼·桑德斯那样，

sentences.en: as Senator Bernie Sanders of Vermont.
sentences.zh: 拥有如此清醒的诊断。

sentences.en: Which is why I gave him a call.
sentences.zh: 这就是我给他打电话的原因。

sentences.en: It's Friday, November 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月15日，星期五。

sentences.en: Hello?
sentences.zh: 喂？

sentences.en: Senator Sanders.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯参议员。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是我。

sentences.en: Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: Hey, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，迈克尔。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Very well.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: I reached Senator Sanders inside his office on Capitol Hill on Thursday morning.
sentences.zh: 周四上午，我在国会山的办公室里联系到了桑德斯参议员。

sentences.en: You may not remember this, but the last time you and I spoke was back in 2020.
sentences.zh: 你可能不记得了，但我们上一次交谈是在2020年。

sentences.en: We were in the same room, and we were working on a profile of you focused on your earliest days in public office as mayor of Burlington.
sentences.zh: 当时我们在同一个房间里，正在为你撰写一篇人物专访，重点关注你担任伯灵顿市长时期的早期公职生涯。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: It's not as vivid a memory for you, apparently, as it is for me.
sentences.zh: 显然，这对你来说记忆没那么深刻，但对我来说却记忆犹新。

sentences.en: Was it a good story?
sentences.zh: 那是个好故事吗？

sentences.en: I thought it was a good story.
sentences.zh: 我觉得是个好故事。

sentences.en: We had our moments, you and I, in that interview, and we don't need to reconstruct the whole thing, but there was a pointed moment where you were frustrated with something I asked.
sentences.zh: 在那次采访中，我们有过一些交锋，没必要重现整个过程，但有一个尖锐的时刻，你对我提出的某个问题感到不满。

sentences.en: You almost got up and left, but then you decided to stay.
sentences.zh: 你差点起身离开，但后来你决定留下来。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Let's do better this time.
sentences.zh: 这次我们争取表现得更好。

sentences.en: Moving on.
sentences.zh: 言归正传。

sentences.en: I just want to begin, Senator, by asking for your reaction to the news of the past 24 hours that Republicans have taken control of the House,
sentences.zh: 参议员，我想先请你谈谈对过去24小时新闻的反应，即共和党已经控制了众议院，

sentences.en: because what that means is that Republicans now control both chambers and the White House.
sentences.zh: 因为这意味着共和党现在同时控制了国会两院和白宫。

sentences.en: You are about to be in the minority.
sentences.zh: 你即将成为少数派。

sentences.en: As President-elect Trump brings a very aggressive agenda to Congress, an agenda, frankly, that Democrats have called, among other things, a threat to democracy.
sentences.zh: 随着当选总统特朗普带着非常激进的议程进入国会——坦率地说，民主党人曾称该议程是对民主的威胁，等等——

sentences.en: So how are you processing that?
sentences.zh: 那么你是如何看待这一点的？

sentences.en: Well, obviously, our job is to rally the American people, to make it clear, especially to working people, that we need an economy and a government that works for all
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然，我们的工作是团结美国人民，明确告诉大家，特别是劳动人民，我们需要一个为所有人服务的经济和政府，

sentences.en: to expose as best we can what Trump and his administration are doing.
sentences.zh: 并尽我们所能揭露特朗普及其政府正在做的事情。

sentences.en: But it's not just an inside-the-beltway game.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅仅是华盛顿圈内的博弈。

sentences.en: It's a question of rallying the American people to fight back effectively.
sentences.zh: 这是一个如何团结美国人民进行有效反击的问题。

sentences.en: So you're in a fighting mood?
sentences.zh: 所以你现在是战斗状态？

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: I think right now, this is a pivotal moment in American history.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在是美国历史上的一个关键时刻。

sentences.en: And the next year or two will determine what happens in this country for decades, in my view.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，未来一两年将决定这个国家未来几十年的走向。

sentences.en: Fighting mood or not, are there any areas where you are prepared to work with the president-elect?
sentences.zh: 不管是不是战斗状态，有没有哪些领域是你准备与当选总统合作的？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然有。

sentences.en: And what might those be?
sentences.zh: 那会是哪些领域呢？

sentences.en: If Trump, for example, follows through on his proposal to limit interest rates on credit cards to 10%, which is what he campaigned on, absolutely, I will be there.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果特朗普兑现他竞选时的承诺，将信用卡利率限制在10%，我绝对会支持。

sentences.en: I think that's a very good idea.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个非常好的主意。

sentences.en: I think it's time we told the people on Wall Street they cannot charge desperate, working-class people who can't have a hard time paying their bills 25%, 30%, 40% interest rates.
sentences.zh: 我认为是时候告诉华尔街的人了，他们不能向那些连账单都难以支付、处于绝望中的工薪阶层收取25%、30%甚至40%的利率。

sentences.en: That's usurious.
sentences.zh: 那是高利贷。

sentences.en: That's immoral.
sentences.zh: 那是不道德的。

sentences.en: And if Trump wants to impose a credit card limit on interest rates, I'll be there.
sentences.zh: 如果特朗普想要对信用卡利率设定上限，我会支持他。

sentences.en: So where your vision of championing the working class overlaps with his, you may back his agenda.
sentences.zh: 所以，在捍卫工薪阶层这一愿景与他重合的地方，你可能会支持他的议程。

sentences.en: If he comes up with reasonable ideas, yes, I would be interested in working with him.
sentences.zh: 如果他提出合理的想法，是的，我有兴趣与他合作。

sentences.en: So let's turn to what I think is going to be the heart of this conversation, Senator Sanders, which is the effort underway across the Democratic Party, and you're a big part of it,
sentences.zh: 那么让我们转向我认为这次谈话的核心，桑德斯参议员，那就是民主党内部正在进行的努力，而你也是其中的重要一员，

sentences.en: of reckoning with the meaning of the outcome of this election.
sentences.zh: 即对这次选举结果的意义进行反思。

sentences.en: And understanding not just why Kamala Harris didn't win, but why Donald Trump in victory
sentences.zh: 不仅要理解为什么卡玛拉·哈里斯没有获胜，还要理解为什么唐纳德·特朗普在获胜时，

sentences.en: expanded his electoral reach into communities of color, into America's youth, into blue state
sentences.zh: 将他的选举版图扩展到了有色人种社区、美国青年群体以及蓝色州，

sentences.en: America, including your own home state of Vermont, where when you look at the New York Times graphic, you see those red arrows suggesting his support deepened since he last ran.
sentences.zh: 包括你自己的家乡佛蒙特州。当你查看《纽约时报》的图表时，你会看到那些红色的箭头，表明他的支持率自上次参选以来有所加深。

sentences.en: Donald Trump has created the most racially and politically diverse coalition of any Republican in a generation.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普创造了整整一代人中种族和政治背景最多元的共和党联盟。

sentences.en: And you have participated, as I said, in the post-mortem underway across the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，你参与了民主党内部正在进行的选后复盘。

sentences.en: And I just want to read something you have said that a lot of people, when they read it, found very bracing.
sentences.zh: 我想读一下你曾经说过的一段话，很多人读到时都感到非常振奋。

sentences.en: This is what you said.
sentences.zh: 你是这样说的。

sentences.en: Quote, it should come as no great surprise that a Democratic Party, which has abandoned working class people, would find that working class people have abandoned them.
sentences.zh: 引用：一个抛弃了工薪阶层的民主党，最终发现工薪阶层也抛弃了他们，这并不令人感到意外。

sentences.en: And you went on to say, first, this abandonment was among white working class Americans.
sentences.zh: 你接着说，首先，这种抛弃发生在白人工薪阶层美国人中。

sentences.en: Now, it is Latino and black workers as well.
sentences.zh: 现在，拉美裔和黑人劳动者也是如此。

sentences.en: While the Democratic leadership defends the status quo, the American people are angry and they want change and they're right.
sentences.zh: 当民主党领导层捍卫现状时，美国人民感到愤怒，他们想要改变，他们是对的。

sentences.en: I want you to just explain what you mean and be very specific, if you can, when you say that the Democratic Party has abandoned the working class.
sentences.zh: 我想请你解释一下你的意思，如果可以的话，请具体说明当你提到民主党抛弃了工薪阶层时指的是什么。

sentences.en: When and how did the Democratic Party abandon the working class?
sentences.zh: 民主党是在何时以及如何抛弃工薪阶层的？

sentences.en: Well, it's something that's been going on for decades, including disastrous trade policies pushed by Bill Clinton.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这种情况已经持续了几十年，包括比尔·克林顿推动的灾难性贸易政策。

sentences.en: You're talking about NAFTA.
sentences.zh: 你指的是《北美自由贸易协定》吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: The reality is the American people, well, many of them, are angry and they have every reason to be angry.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，美国人民，嗯，他们中的许多人，感到愤怒，而且他们有充分的理由感到愤怒。

sentences.en: Today in America, and sometimes, you know, some of the elite does not understand this.
sentences.zh: 在今天的美国，有时，你知道，一些精英阶层并不理解这一点。

sentences.en: Today in America, 60% of our people are living paycheck to paycheck.
sentences.zh: 在今天的美国，60%的人靠薪水度日。

sentences.en: I grew up in a family that lived paycheck to paycheck.
sentences.zh: 我成长在一个靠薪水度日的家庭。

sentences.en: I understand the stress involved in that.
sentences.zh: 我理解其中的压力。

sentences.en: It means that if your car breaks down, you don't know how you get to work.
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果你的车坏了，你不知道该怎么去上班。

sentences.en: If you get sick, you don't know whether or not you can afford to go to a doctor.
sentences.zh: 如果你生病了，你不知道自己是否负担得起去看医生。

sentences.en: If your landlord raises rent by 20%, you don't know where you're going to live, where your kid is going to go to school.
sentences.zh: 如果你的房东把房租提高了20%，你不知道自己该住哪儿，不知道孩子该去哪儿上学。

sentences.en: That's the reality facing 60% of the American people.
sentences.zh: 这就是60%的美国人所面临的现实。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the very wealthiest people in this country have never, ever had it so good.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这个国家最富有的人却从未像现在这样过得如此滋润。

sentences.en: That's a reality.
sentences.zh: 这就是现实。

sentences.en: So what happened in this campaign is Donald Trump said to the American people, you're angry.
sentences.zh: 所以这次竞选中发生的事情是，唐纳德·特朗普对美国人民说，你们很愤怒。

sentences.en: You're really pissed off.
sentences.zh: 你们真的非常火大。

sentences.en: And I know that.
sentences.zh: 我知道这一点。

sentences.en: And you're right.
sentences.zh: 而且你们是对的。

sentences.en: And then he gave his explanation.
sentences.zh: 然后他给出了他的解释。

sentences.en: And his explanation, which was obviously nonsense and false and racist, et cetera, was that millions and millions of undocumented people were coming across the border.
sentences.zh: 他的解释——显然是胡说八道、虚假且带有种族主义色彩等等——是数以百万计的无证移民正在越过边境。

sentences.en: They were invading America.
sentences.zh: 他们正在入侵美国。

sentences.en: We're an occupied country.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个被占领的国家。

sentences.en: They were taking your jobs, taking your benefits, eating your cats and your dogs.
sentences.zh: 他们抢走了你们的工作，拿走了你们的福利，吃掉了你们的猫和狗。

sentences.en: That is why you are hurting.
sentences.zh: 这就是你们痛苦的原因。

sentences.en: Now, that is a crazy explanation.
sentences.zh: 现在，这是一个疯狂的解释。

sentences.en: But it is an explanation.
sentences.zh: 但它确实是一个解释。

sentences.en: Now, you tell me what the Democratic explanation was.
sentences.zh: 现在，你告诉我民主党的解释是什么。

sentences.en: Well, please, please, please explore that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，请，请，请深入探讨一下。

sentences.en: Map this critique onto the Democratic campaign and its shortcomings.
sentences.zh: 将这一批评映射到民主党的竞选活动及其短板上。

sentences.en: Well, the Democratic explanation was, hey, we have passed some good things, very important things in the Biden administration, which happens to be true.
sentences.zh: 嗯，民主党的解释是，嘿，我们在拜登政府期间通过了一些好的政策，非常重要的政策，这恰好是事实。

sentences.en: Biden kept his word.
sentences.zh: 拜登信守了承诺。

sentences.en: He was the most progressive president on domestic issues since FDr.
sentences.zh: 他是自富兰克林·罗斯福以来在内政问题上最进步的总统。

sentences.en: We did a lot of good things.
sentences.zh: 我们做了很多好事。

sentences.en: But instead of saying, yeah, we are rebuilding our crumbling infrastructure, we're lowering
sentences.zh: 但我们没有说，是的，我们正在重建破败的基础设施，我们正在降低，

sentences.en: the cost of prescription drugs, we are transforming our energy system, we forgave student debt for five million people, we're making some progress.
sentences.zh: 处方药的成本，我们正在改造能源系统，我们为五百万人免除了学生贷款，我们正在取得一些进展。

sentences.en: But we have a long, long way to go.
sentences.zh: 但我们还有很长很长的路要走。

sentences.en: Wait, can I just pause you?
sentences.zh: 等等，我能打断一下吗？

sentences.en: Because I think I'm not certain I'm understanding something.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得我不确定我是否理解了某件事。

sentences.en: Where did the campaign of Kamala Harris go wrong if it was working with what you're describing as the building blocks of a successful policy agenda?
sentences.zh: 如果卡玛拉·哈里斯的竞选活动是在利用你所描述的成功政策议程的基石，那么它究竟哪里出了问题？

sentences.en: And I know that you have said many, many times.
sentences.zh: 我知道你已经说过很多很多次了。

sentences.en: It's not just Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是卡玛拉·哈里斯的问题。

sentences.en: In other words, let me read you something, if I might.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，如果可以的话，让我为你读一段话。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: What I think is one of the most interesting speeches ever given.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是有史以来最有趣的演讲之一。

sentences.en: Franklin Delano Roosevelt's inaugural speech in 1936, middle of the Depression.
sentences.zh: 富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福1936年的就职演说，正值大萧条时期。
zh_words: 富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福

sentences.en: So he starts his speech.
sentences.zh: 他开始演讲时说。

sentences.en: He says, look, these are the things we did.
sentences.zh: 他说，看，这些是我们所做的事情。

sentences.en: These are the obstacles that we had to overcome.
sentences.zh: 这些是我们必须克服的障碍。

sentences.en: And then he says, after being president for four years, he says that I quote, I see millions
sentences.zh: 然后他说，在担任总统四年后，他说，引用：我看到数以百万计的家庭，

sentences.en: of families trying to live on income so meager that the pall of family disaster hangs over them day by day.
sentences.zh: 试图依靠微薄的收入生活，家庭灾难的阴影日复一日地笼罩着他们。

sentences.en: I see millions of night education, recreation, and the opportunity to better their lot and the lot of their children.
sentences.zh: 我看到数以百万计的人缺乏教育、娱乐，以及改善他们自己和孩子命运的机会。

sentences.en: I see one third of a nation ill-housed, ill-clad, ill-nourished, end quote.
sentences.zh: 我看到三分之一的国家住房条件恶劣、衣不蔽体、营养不良，引用结束。

sentences.en: In other words, what Roosevelt did is said, look, we're making progress.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，罗斯福所做的是说，看，我们正在取得进展。

sentences.en: But I look out all over this country and I see tens of millions of people who are hurting.
sentences.zh: 但我放眼全国，我看到数以千万计的人正在受苦。

sentences.en: Instead of doing that, the Democrats said, well, we passed the Inflation Adjustment Act and the economy is pretty good.
sentences.zh: 民主党人没有这样做，而是说，嗯，我们通过了《通胀削减法案》，经济还不错。

sentences.en: And Donald Trump's a bad guy.
sentences.zh: 而唐纳德·特朗普是个坏人。

sentences.en: We all defend the women's constitutional right to an abortion.
sentences.zh: 我们都捍卫女性堕胎的宪法权利。

sentences.en: There was no appreciation, no appreciation of the struggling and the suffering of millions and millions of working class people.
sentences.zh: 他们完全没有体会，完全没有体会到数以百万计工薪阶层人民的挣扎和痛苦。

sentences.en: And unless you recognize that reality and have a vision of how you get out of that, I think you're not going to be going very far as a political party.
sentences.zh: 除非你认识到这一现实，并对如何摆脱困境有愿景，否则我认为作为一个政党，你不会走得太远。

sentences.en: You're saying that the party in this last election didn't communicate that they understood
sentences.zh: 你是说在这个最后一次选举中，该党没有传达出他们理解，

sentences.en: Americans' pain.
sentences.zh: 美国人的痛苦。

sentences.en: As a result, they came off as defending the status quo.
sentences.zh: 结果，他们表现得像是在捍卫现状。

sentences.en: And I mean, I don't think it's a stretch to suggest that Kamala Harris was asked repeatedly
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为说卡玛拉·哈里斯被反复问到，

sentences.en: what she would do differently in this campaign and pretty much said she didn't think anything needed to be done differently.
sentences.zh: 她在这次竞选中会做些什么不同的事情，而她几乎说她认为不需要做任何不同的事情，这并不夸张。

sentences.en: And she didn't campaign on disruption or large-scale change.
sentences.zh: 而且她没有以颠覆或大规模变革为竞选纲领。

sentences.en: The point that I am making is that ordinary people are not stupid.
sentences.zh: 我提出的观点是，普通人并不愚蠢。

sentences.en: They think he's insensitive.
sentences.zh: 你为《纽约时报》工作，对吧？

sentences.en: He's not one of them.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And since then, we found out some voters viewed that Rogan interview with Trump as kind of decisive in their decision to vote for Trump.
sentences.zh: 我想他们给了每位成员——大约20名成员，我不记得了——每人两票，对吧？

sentences.en: Are Democrats writing off too many places and too many mediums in this moment and making a mistake in their ability to reach working class voters where they are?
sentences.zh: 当时我在民调中要么领先，要么排在第二位。

sentences.en: Well, funny you ask that, Michael.
sentences.zh: 在投出的40票中，我只得到了一票。

sentences.en: I am thinking back to when I ran for president in 2020 and I did an interview with the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 这就是《纽约时报》对我竞选活动的看法。

sentences.en: You work for the New York Times, right?
sentences.zh: 然而，我现在作为《纽约时报》的一名员工出现在你的节目中。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我害怕出现在你的节目中吗？

sentences.en: Of which I think they gave each member, 20 members or so, I don't remember, two votes apiece, right?
sentences.zh: 我不怕。

sentences.en: I was either ahead or in second place in the polls at that time.
sentences.zh: 当时在民调中，我不是领先就是排在第二。

sentences.en: And of the 40 votes that were cast, I got one of the votes.
sentences.zh: 在投出的40张选票中，我只得到了一票。

sentences.en: That was what the New York Times thought of my campaign.
sentences.zh: 这就是《纽约时报》对我竞选活动的看法。

sentences.en: And yet here I am on your show as an employee of the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 然而，我现在却作为《纽约时报》的一名员工出现在你的节目中。

sentences.en: Am I afraid of being on your show?
sentences.zh: 我害怕上你的节目吗？

sentences.en: I am not.
sentences.zh: 我不怕。

sentences.en: Am I afraid of being on Joe Rogan's show?
sentences.zh: 我害怕上乔·罗根的节目吗？

sentences.en: No, bottom line is what every communications director knows is that there is a new world of media out there.
sentences.zh: 不，归根结底，每一位传播总监都知道，现在是一个全新的媒体世界。

sentences.en: And it's not just NBC, CBS, or the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是美国全国广播公司（NBC）、哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）或《纽约时报》的天下。

sentences.en: It is podcasts.
sentences.zh: 还有播客。

sentences.en: It is Joe Rogan.
sentences.zh: 还有乔·罗根。

sentences.en: It is Fox News.
sentences.zh: 还有福克斯新闻。

sentences.en: It is young people who nobody in the Democratic leadership has ever heard of who have YouTube programs that attract millions of people.
sentences.zh: 还有那些民主党领导层闻所未闻的年轻人，他们经营的 YouTube 频道吸引了数百万观众。

sentences.en: That is the reality.
sentences.zh: 这就是现实。

sentences.en: Can you ignore that?
sentences.zh: 你能无视这一点吗？

sentences.en: That is insane.
sentences.zh: 那太荒谬了。

sentences.en: Anyone who thinks you could ignore that reality is crazy.
sentences.zh: 任何认为可以无视这一现实的人都是疯子。

sentences.en: In my experience, not that I've been on millions of these shows, the people that I talk to treat me with respect.
sentences.zh: 根据我的经验——并不是说我上过数百万次这种节目——我交谈过的人都对我表现出了尊重。

sentences.en: And I think you cannot be, you know, oh, Joe Rogan said this or he says that.
sentences.zh: 我认为你不能总是纠结于“噢，乔·罗根说了这个或那个”。

sentences.en: Yeah, so what?
sentences.zh: 那又怎样？

sentences.en: You know, my wife disagrees with me on this or that issue.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我妻子在某些问题上也和我意见不合。

sentences.en: So what?
sentences.zh: 那又怎样？

sentences.en: You can't run away from somebody because they may have said something stupid or something that you disagree with.
sentences.zh: 你不能因为某人可能说了蠢话或者与你意见不合就避开他们。

sentences.en: That's life.
sentences.zh: 这就是生活。

sentences.en: But most importantly, when you go on the show, what do you say?
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，当你上节目时，你会说什么？

sentences.en: Hey, so Joe Rogan asked you, what do you think about the fact that we have more income and wealth inequality than ever before?
sentences.zh: 嘿，如果乔·罗根问你，对于我们现在面临着前所未有的贫富差距，你有什么看法？

sentences.en: Oh, well, I can't answer that question.
sentences.zh: 噢，好吧，我没法回答这个问题。

sentences.en: What do you think about the fact that we're the only major country not to guarantee a health care?
sentences.zh: 对于我们是唯一一个没有全民医保的主要国家，你有什么看法？

sentences.en: Well, gee, I'd like to not talk about that, but I don't want to offend the insurance companies.
sentences.zh: 嗯，天哪，我不想谈论这个，但我也不想得罪保险公司。

sentences.en: Why are we paying the highest prices in the world for prescription drugs?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们要支付世界上最高的处方药价格？

sentences.en: Well, I can't talk about that because, you know, I get money from the pharma.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不能谈论这个，因为你知道，我拿了制药公司的钱。

sentences.en: That's the problem.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: So, yeah, you've got to go on different outlets.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，你必须去不同的媒体平台。

sentences.en: Of course you do.
sentences.zh: 你当然得去。

sentences.en: But most importantly, you've got to know what you believe and what you're prepared to fight for and what your vision for the future of this country is.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，你必须清楚自己的信仰，清楚你准备为之奋斗的目标，以及你对这个国家未来的愿景是什么。

sentences.en: Do you think that the Democratic Party is really prepared to go where it needs to go in taking the lessons that you're laying out here and really moving ahead with them?
sentences.zh: 你认为民主党真的准备好采取你在这里提出的建议，并真正推动它们向前发展了吗？

sentences.en: I don't know if you know that former Speaker Nancy Pelosi came on a podcast by our colleague, Lulu Garcia Navarro, and was presented with your critique, word for word,
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是否知道，前议长南希·佩洛西曾参加过我们同事露露·加西亚·纳瓦罗的播客，并被逐字逐句地告知了你的批评，

sentences.en: of the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 关于民主党的批评。

sentences.en: And if I can put it politely, she dismissed it and said, well, I completely disagree with what he's saying.
sentences.zh: 如果我客气一点说，她驳回了这些批评，并说，好吧，我完全不同意他所说的。

sentences.en: By the way, Kamala Harris did better than, you know, Senator Sanders in Vermont on Election Day.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，卡玛拉·哈里斯在选举日那天在佛蒙特州的表现比桑德斯参议员要好。

sentences.en: She pointed out you've lost your races for president in Democratic primaries.
sentences.zh: 她指出你在民主党初选中输掉了总统竞选。

sentences.en: Well, I tell you, I got 63% of the vote and I didn't spend one nickel on advertising in Vermont.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我告诉你，我在佛蒙特州获得了 63% 的选票，而且我一分钱广告费都没花。

sentences.en: How's that?
sentences.zh: 怎么样？

sentences.en: Look, I respect Nancy and we've known each other for years and we've worked together on some issues like the American Rescue Plan,
sentences.zh: 听着，我尊重南希，我们认识多年了，在一些问题上我们也合作过，比如《美国救援计划》，

sentences.en: which I thought was a very consequential piece of legislation.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是一项非常有影响力的立法。

sentences.en: But, you know, Nancy and I have different visions as to the future.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，南希和我在未来愿景上存在分歧。

sentences.en: I think Nancy's views may reverberate here inside the Beltway.
sentences.zh: 我认为南希的观点可能在华盛顿特区内部引起共鸣。

sentences.en: I'm sure a lot of the pundits and the consultants and politicians agree with Nancy.
sentences.zh: 我相信很多权威人士、顾问和政客都同意南希的看法。

sentences.en: I suspect if you go out into the hinterlands, you'll find that most people agree with me.
sentences.zh: 但我怀疑如果你去偏远地区看看，你会发现大多数人都同意我的看法。

sentences.en: Senator, looking forward to not just the idea that the party will take what you're saying and perhaps run with it, but that it needs to be embodied in a candidate who can win.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我们不仅期待党派能采纳你的建议并付诸实践，还期待这些理念能体现在一位能胜选的候选人身上。

sentences.en: When you close your eyes and think of who can lead the party out of this very decisive and, for many Democrats, devastating loss, what do you see?
sentences.zh: 当你闭上眼睛，思考谁能带领民主党走出这次决定性的、对许多民主党人来说是毁灭性的失败时，你看到了什么？

sentences.en: Not necessarily who do you see.
sentences.zh: 不一定是“谁”是你看到的。

sentences.en: I mean, maybe there is a who in your mind, but what is that future candidate?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，也许你心中有一个人选，但未来的候选人应该是什么样的？

sentences.en: Look, it's a candidate, preferably, but not necessarily, somebody from the working class who can speak to working class people,
sentences.zh: 听着，最好是一位候选人，但不一定非要是工人阶级出身，但他必须能与工人阶级对话，

sentences.en: who will fight to end all forms of bigotry in this country,
sentences.zh: 他会为终结这个国家一切形式的偏见而战，

sentences.en: but is mostly prepared to take on the big money interests who today have an unprecedented level of economic and political power.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，他准备好对抗那些如今拥有前所未有的经济和政治权力的巨额资本利益集团。

sentences.en: With the advent of all the new technologies out there, Michael, in terms of artificial intelligence, in terms of robotics, etc.,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，随着人工智能、机器人技术等新技术的出现，

sentences.en: we truthfully have the capability now of creating a society where all of our people have a decent standard of living.
sentences.zh: 我们现在确实有能力创造一个让所有人都能享有体面生活水平的社会。

sentences.en: Yeah, we can actually wipe out poverty.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们实际上可以消除贫困。

sentences.en: We don't need to have people sleeping out on the streets.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要让人们露宿街头。

sentences.en: The question is, who will control the utilization of that technology and who will benefit from it?
sentences.zh: 问题是，谁来控制这些技术的利用，谁将从中受益？

sentences.en: So we need to have somebody who primarily is prepared to stand up to the ruling class of America and say, you know what?
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要一个主要准备好站出来对抗美国统治阶级并说“你知道吗？”的人，

sentences.en: We like your entrepreneurial capabilities, but you've got to control your greed.
sentences.zh: 我们欣赏你们的创业能力，但你们必须控制自己的贪婪。

sentences.en: You can no longer have it all.
sentences.zh: 你们不能再拥有一切了。

sentences.en: You're going to be an important part of the future, but you're not going to own and control the future.
sentences.zh: 你们将成为未来的重要组成部分，但你们不能拥有和控制未来。

sentences.en: We need somebody like that.
sentences.zh: 我们需要这样的人。

sentences.en: Do you think that if Democrats do meet voters where they are and connect with the pain and they pitch the kind of progressive policies that you're advocating for here,
sentences.zh: 你认为如果民主党人真正深入选民群体，与他们的痛苦产生共鸣，并推行你在这里倡导的那种进步政策，

sentences.en: especially on economics, that is the winning combination?
sentences.zh: 特别是在经济方面，这会是制胜组合吗？

sentences.en: Or has trust in the Democratic Party, for a lot of the reasons we've been talking about here, been strained,
sentences.zh: 还是说，由于我们在这里讨论的许多原因，对民主党的信任已经变得紧张，

sentences.en: if not broken in a way that means that even getting it right here is not really possible?
sentences.zh: 甚至已经破裂，以至于即使做对了这些，也不再可能成功了？

sentences.en: Well, that's a very good question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: Because there's been a huge loss of faith in government.
sentences.zh: 因为人们对政府的信心已经严重丧失。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You're right on that.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: And I will tell you that even within the confines of the Democratic caucus, and I don't talk about things that happen behind closed doors, but you'll have Democrats, U.S.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，即使在民主党党团内部——我不谈论闭门会议发生的事情——但你会有民主党参议员站出来说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: senators standing up and saying, you know what?
sentences.zh: 外面的人讨厌我们。

sentences.en: They hate us out there.
sentences.zh: 是我们，政府，还是党派？

sentences.en: Us, the government, or the party?
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们讨厌这个党派，而且他们明白这一点，你提到的另一个问题，我们现在没时间深入探讨。

sentences.en: Well, they hate the party, and they understand, and you're on to another issue, which we don't have time to get into right now.
sentences.zh: 即使政府做了正确的事，官僚机构在执行政策时也太慢了，以至于人们在应该看到成果的时候却看不到。

sentences.en: Even when government does the right thing, you've got a bureaucracy, which is so slow in implementation of policy that people don't see it when they should be seeing it.
sentences.zh: 但这又是另一个问题了。

sentences.en: But that's a whole other issue.
sentences.zh: 这是另一个问题，也许是另一场对话，但如果人们对政府没有信心，那么你那些确实需要政府发挥巨大作用的解决方案，

sentences.en: It's another issue and perhaps another conversation, but if people don't have faith in government, how do your solutions, which do require a tremendous role for our government,
sentences.zh: 你该如何推销它们？

sentences.en: how do you sell them?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这又是一个好问题。

sentences.en: Well, that's, again, a good question.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们现在的处境是这样的。

sentences.en: And I think here's where we're at.
sentences.zh: 像埃隆·马斯克那样的人会说，看，政府什么也做不了。

sentences.en: The Elon Musk's of the world will say, look, government can't do anything.
sentences.zh: 还得靠私营部门。

sentences.en: It's going to be the private sector.
sentences.zh: 削减、削减、再削减，这就是他的信息，对吧？

sentences.en: Cut it, cut it, cut it is his message, right?
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，看，埃隆·马斯克是一位非常、非常有进取心且能力出众的商人，他的成就令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: And, you know, look, Elon Musk is a very, very aggressive and capable business person, very impressive of what he's accomplished.
sentences.zh: 他说，我一周内能做的事情比政府五年内能做的还要多。

sentences.en: And he says, I can do more in a week than the government can do in, you know, five years.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，他是对的。

sentences.en: In some ways, he is right.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，在他努力之后，他赚了天文数字的钱，而工人阶级并没有变得更好。

sentences.en: The problem is, at the end of his efforts, he ends up making zillions of dollars and working class people are not any better off.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 另一种选择是说，噢，现在就让政府来做吧。

sentences.en: The alternative is to say, oh, let the government do it right now.
sentences.zh: 但你面对的是一个效率低下且官僚主义严重的政府。

sentences.en: But you've got a government that is inefficient and bureaucratic.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 所以人们看着这一切说，好吧，我们有统治阶级的贪婪。

sentences.en: So people are looking and say, all right, we've got the greed of the ruling class.
sentences.zh: 他们确实把事情做得很好，但最终所有的钱都进了他们的口袋。

sentences.en: They do things pretty well, but they end up with all the money.
sentences.zh: 而工人阶级的生活水平却降到了最低。

sentences.en: And the working class ends up with the lowest standard of living than the U staff.
sentences.zh: 或者你有一个在做任何事情上都非常缓慢的政府。

sentences.en: Or you've got a government which is very slow in doing anything.
sentences.zh: 所以，在我看来，这就是我们作为一个国家所处的境地。

sentences.en: So that is, it seems to me, where we are as a nation.
sentences.zh: 我们必须做得比这更好。

sentences.en: We've got to do better than that.
sentences.zh: 答案是什么？

sentences.en: What's the answer?
sentences.zh: 答案是让那些相信改善人民生活使命的年轻人进入政府，无论你是在邮局工作，

sentences.en: The answer is to bring young people into government who believe in a mission to improve the lives of people, whether you work in the post office,
sentences.zh: 还是在退伍军人事务部工作，还是在社会保障局工作。

sentences.en: whether you work in the Veterans Administration, whether you work in Social Security.
sentences.zh: 给这些人优厚的报酬，给他们良好的管理，让他们为自己所从事的重要工作感到自豪。

sentences.en: Pay these people well, give them good management, let them be proud of the important work that they are doing.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家，没有比成为一名公立学校教师更重要的工作了。

sentences.en: No more important work in this country than being a public school teacher.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 然而我们却给这些老师过低的报酬。

sentences.en: Yet we underpay those teachers.
sentences.zh: 我们把他们置于糟糕的工作环境中。

sentences.en: We put them under terrible working conditions.
sentences.zh: 选择必须是现代化政府，让政府为普通人服务，为所有人提供医疗保健，对吧？

sentences.en: Choice has got to be to modernize government, make government work for ordinary people, health care for all of them, right?
sentences.zh: 如果世界上的其他国家都能拥有全民医疗保健计划，美国也可以。

sentences.en: If other countries around the world can have national health care programs, so can the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 我们并不比别人笨。

sentences.en: We're not dumb on other people.
sentences.zh: 我有一个最后一个问题要问你。

sentences.en: I have a final question for you.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普上次获胜时，许多民主党人组织起来，组成了有时被他们自己称为“抵抗运动”的组织。

sentences.en: When Trump won last time, many Democrats organized themselves into what was loosely described, sometimes by them, as the resistance.
sentences.zh: 许多民主党人现在认为，那场抵抗运动最终将党派推向了越来越左的立场，

sentences.en: That resistance, many Democrats now think, ended up pushing the party further and further to the left,
sentences.zh: 导致了像 2020 年初选那样的情况，当时像卡玛拉·哈里斯这样的人对左翼事业做出了承诺，这些承诺后来反过来困扰了她，并使共和党人能够——

sentences.en: leading to things like a primary in 2020 in which people like Kamala Harris made commitments to left-wing causes that came back to haunt her and made it possible for Republicans—
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在你又在谈论另一个问题了。

sentences.en: All right, well, now you're on to another.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这就是你大错特错的地方。

sentences.en: Michael, this is where you're dead wrong.
sentences.zh: 这是我的最后一个问题。

sentences.en: This is my final question.
sentences.zh: 你是否担心该党可能再次走上那条抵抗运动的道路——

sentences.en: Do you worry that the party could be heading down that path again of resistance—
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你根本没听进去我说的一个字。

sentences.en: Michael, you haven't heard a word that I've said.
sentences.zh: 这真令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: And that's impressive.
sentences.zh: 你知道，卡玛拉谈论的事情，我谈论的事情，每一个问题都非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: You know, it's—the things that Kamala was talking about, the things that I was talking about, every one of those issues is enormously popular.
sentences.zh: 你指的是那个吗？

sentences.en: Is that what you're talking about?
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 我是指社会议题。

sentences.en: I mean on social issues.
sentences.zh: 噢，我不知道。

sentences.en: Oh, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 你知道，社会议题，你知道，主要——我不知道。

sentences.en: You know, social issues, you know, chief—I don't know.
